title: Physics: bodies 2D
shows: @mcthaydt/automata-physics/2d inside base-2d's sim. The room's tiles are fixed bodies, an invisible kinematic box follows Wick, and crates and stones are dynamic bodies: Wick shoves them, they tumble down the ledges and pile up. Drop more and watch the collision events count up. Physics runs inside the sim (sim/bodies.plugin.ts), so the pile is the same on every engine (golden.parity.test.ts); this page only sends the drops and draws the bodies.
controls: arrows or A/D to move, Space, Z, W or Up to jump, B, X or C to drop a body above Wick; on-screen buttons on touch (▣ drops).
base: base-2d (`@af-examples/base-2d`: the room, Wick, input and the loop through `playRoom`).

title: UI: primitives
Content: hot reload
shows: the room as a content file (content/room.toml) compiled by automata-content, and edited live. Run `pnpm --filter @af-examples/content-hot-reload dev`, open the page, change a tile in content/room.toml and save: Wick's room is rebuilt in place, on a fresh sim, without reloading the page. Save a mistake (a row of the wrong width, a second P) and the compiler's message shows over the room, which stays as it last compiled; the next good save clears it. A production build embeds the content and its hash, and never reloads.
controls: arrows or A/D to move, Space, Z, W or Up to jump; on-screen buttons on touch.
base: base-2d (`@af-examples/base-2d`: the room, Wick, input and the loop through `playRoom`).

title: Emberwick: Base 2D Adventure
shows: a complete small game on `startGame`. A pixel-art character runs and jumps through one single-screen room to an ember (Wick, a hooded lantern-bearer in mossy ruins at night, Endesga 64, lit by pixel lights), through splash → menu → room → pause → end. The runtime completes the Ruken handshake and draws nothing before the host says ready; opened directly, it runs standalone.
controls: arrows or A/D to move, Space, Z, W or Up to jump, Escape or P to pause; on-screen buttons on touch.
base: this is the 2D base. Demos build on it through `@af-examples/base-2d`.
